descriptionChanges.before: The supplied PartyId, at most 128 characters, shared by the root and every child operation; tenant comes from the gateway envelope. Parties accepts legacy braced, parenthesized and X-format GUID IDs, but their McpCli/Gateway reachability remains unproven.
